title: Anutap
desc: A singer falls in love with a village beauty, and soon they get married. However, their marital bliss is dampened when they are separated due to an unfortunate event.

title: Baba Taraknath
desc: Amar, an explorer conducting research on snake venom, loves Sudha and the two get married. However, their marital bliss is dampened when an astrologer predicts Amar's death.

title: Bidrohini Naari
desc: Saathi, a rebel, marries a rich man named Partho, but his family fails to welcome her. However, when her maid gets molested by her brother-in-law, she raises her voice against her in-laws.

title: Agnipath
desc: Sujay, Ajay and Bijay are three siblings who share a close bond and can go to any length to protect each other. However, when Sujay is killed by his own boss, Bijay sets out to exact revenge.
